description: Versatile Measuring Device: The BOSCH GLM 40 Laser Distance Meter offers a wide range of measurement capabilities, including area, distance, length, volume, continuous measurement, addition, and subtraction. It can accurately measure distances of up to 40 meters, making it suitable for various tasks. This device can be used by civil engineers, electricians, and painters for hall construction and for work on windows and doors. Memory Function: This Laser Measuring Device can conveniently store up to 10 measurements, which enhances productivity. The real-time laser measurements adjust dynamically as you move closer or farther away, simulating the functionality of a traditional tape measure. It has a user-friendly interface that simplifies various measuring functions, ensuring that it can be operated easily by anyone. Accuracy: The GLM 40 Laser Distance Meter provides measurements with an impressive accuracy of ±0.15 m across distances from 0.05 to 40.00 m, ensuring precision for all your projects. Ergonomic & Portable: Designed for portability, the pocket-sized GLM 40 Laser Distance Meter features a shape that allows for easy handling and measuring from any flat surface. Its compact design fits easily into any pocket, making it a convenient tool for quick measurements whenever needed. Reliable Measuring: It results in all conditions proven by ISO certification. With IP54 dust and splash water protection, the GLM 40 Laser Distance Meter is designed to withstand the toughest job site conditions, featuring a soft grip for all-around comfort and a robust design that ensures reliable measuring results in any environment.
